description: Several dozen individuals of indeterminate species, older than any other old-growth in the Feywood. The Elder Trees predate the Heartwood's central role and form the foundational substrate of the Feywood's root-memory network. Never harvested.

ecology.cultural_role: sacred; older than any other old-growth; never harvested
ecology.ecological_role: foundational substrate of the Feywood's root-memory network

name: The Elder Trees of the Silent Grove
